children: has signed a first contract to supply 0.5 million metric tons of liquefied natural gas to southern Vietnam, the head of the company was reported as saying by the RIA news agency.
Leonid Mikhelson also said Novatek has been in talks about LNG supplies to Thailand, RIA reported.
Mikhelson was speaking on the sidelines of an Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in the southern Chinese technology hub of Shenzhen.

Vietnamese state energy company Petrovietnam earlier said it discussed potential cooperation in liquefied natural gas and liquefied petroleum gas with a delegation from Russia's Leningrad Region, home to a large Russian LNG project that has yet to start operations.
Russia's exports of LNG declined by 2.5% in 2025 to 31.3 million metric tons, LSEG data shows.
LNG exports from Russia have been curbed by US sanctions, notably against the new Arctic LNG 2 plant. The sanctions have also limited the use of Russia's tanker fleet for fuel transportation.
Europe also plans to completely shun Russian LNG from 2027.
